fact: The ministers launched APIM digital services on 4 April 2025 letting investors create companies online through the 'Mes services' portal.
Company creation through the portal yields a commerce register entry, a tax registration and social security (CNSS) affiliation in a single procedure.

A Ministry of Digital Transformation official lists the digitisation of company-creation procedures and investment-licence applications through the APIM platform among the department's achieved projects.
